identity.title: Pokémon Ranger and the Prince of the Sea: Manaphy Music Collection

leadText: Pokémon Ranger and the Prince of the Sea: Manaphy Music Collection is the original Japanese soundtrack CD of the 9th Pokémon movie, Pokémon Ranger and the Temple of the Sea. It was released in Japan on July 26, 2006.
plainText:
Pokémon Ranger and the Prince of the Sea: Manaphy Music Collection is the original Japanese soundtrack CD of the 9th Pokémon movie, Pokémon Ranger and the Temple of the Sea. It was released in Japan on July 26, 2006.

==Tracklist==
Pokémon of the Sea (海のポケモン達 Umi no Pokémon tachi)
Phantom Appears (ファントム登場 Phantom Toujou)
Pokémon Ranger Appears! ~Mission of E.O.P~ (ポケモンレンジャー登場！！～ミッション・オブ・EOP～ Pokémon Ranger Toujou!! ~Mission of EOP~)
Movie 2006 Title Theme (劇場タイトルテーマ2006 Gekijou Title Thema 2006)
Opening ~Underwater Pokémon Show~ (オープニング～水中ポケモンショー～ Opening ~Suichuu Pokémon Show~)
's Dream (ハルカの夢 no Yume)
~Capture On~ (オニドリル～キャプチャオン～ ~Capture On~)
Phantom Troops Attack! (ファントムトループ来襲！！ Phantom Troop Raishuu!!)
Ruins of the People of the Water (水の民の遺跡 Mizu no Tami no Iseki)
Legend of Samiya (レジェンド・オブ・アクーシャ Legend of Akusha)
Ambition (野望に向かって Yabou ni Mukatte)
Don't Hesitate About the Adventure with the Youth (若さとは冒険をためらわないこと Wakasa to wa Bouken wo Tamerawanai Koto)
Departure! To a Voyage! (出発！航海へ！ Shupputsu! Koukai he!)
Each Thought (それぞれの思い Sorezore no Omoi)
For (マナフィのために Manaphy no Tameni)
Fun with Manaphy! (マナフィと遊ぼう！ Manaphy to Asobu!)
Find Manaphy! (マナフィを探せ！！ Manaphy wo Sagase!!)
Samiya, the Sea Temple (海の神殿アクーシャ Umi no Shinden Akusha)
Waltz of the Temple (神殿のワルツ Shinden no Waltz)
To the Crown of the Sea (海の王冠へ Umi no Oukan he)
The Temple Sinks (沈みだす神殿 Shizumi dasu Shinden)
Save the Temple! (神殿を救え！！ Shinden wo Sukue!!)
As Long As I Can Hold My Breath... (息の続く限り… Iki no Tsuzuku Kagiri...)
Embracing the Crown of the Sea (海の王冠に抱かれて Umi no Oukan ni Idakarete)
, Warrior of Light (光の戦士サトシ Hikari no Senshi )
The People of the Water's Carnival (水の民のカーニバル Mizu no Tami no Carnival)
Prince of the Sea (海の王子 Umi no Ouji)
A Thing to be Protected (Movie Version) (守るべきもの （映画バージョン） Mamoru-beki Mono (Eiga Version)) - Sowelu
Spurt! (TV Version) (スパート！ （TVバージョン） Spurt! (TV Version)) - Rica Matsumoto
Big Meowth Day (Movie Version) (ビッグ・ニャース・ディ （映画バージョン） Big Nyarth Day (Eiga Version))

==Related articles==
